Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. High level: yes, we can support the audit window and provide a SOC 2 Type II report plus a short bridge letter if needed. For the scoped artifacts you requested we can provide:

- a bridge letter covering the precise audit window if our Type II report's period doesn't fully align;
- an auth-log slice (CSV) containing timestamps, event type, user pseudonym id, MFA success/failure, and source IP (we can redact or pseudonymize user identifiers per your preference);
- an MFA enforcement snapshot (PNG) showing policy and enforcement state from our admin console as of 2026-08-31;

Proposed ETA: initial artifact bundle (bridge letter draft + retention policy + MFA snapshot) by Tue 2026-09-14 EOD PT; auth-log slice and chain-of-custody by Thu 2026-09-16 (depending on scope/redaction). Let us know the preferred redaction approach.
